_comment: Overrides for tools/bake_arch_mesh.py. Everything here is optional; the baker only needs it when filenames are ambiguous or the scan is mirrored.
_teeth: Map a filename to a Palmer designation (LL1-LL8, LR1-LR8) when the name does not contain exactly one. Universal and FDI numbers are accepted here too and translated. Use null to skip a file -- that is what the combined-arch STL wants.
_orientation: --report ends with a crown check: it counts the teeth whose wider end lands at +z. Teeth are broader at the crown than at the root, so 'N up' means +z came out occlusal and the scan is oriented correctly. If it says CROWNS APICAL, one of the two keys below fixes it -- and only you can say which, because they look identical from the geometry.
_mirror_z: The scan was exported mirrored. Reflects world z before anything measures the mesh, and reverses triangle winding to match, so the crown cut, the oriented boxes and the baked face normals all see the corrected tooth. Use this one when the mesh itself is a mirror image; no rotation can undo that.
_flip_z: The LL and LR filenames are swapped. A 180-degree turn about +y, which leaves the geometry untouched and moves every tooth to the other side of the arch. Use this one when the scan is fine and only the naming is wrong.
_scale: Scan-units-to-world scale. Leave null to normalise the arch to the extent the view is tuned for; set it only to pin a bake against an earlier one.
